student:applications.emptyText.ko: 매칭 결과에서 프로그램을 골라 시작하세요. 내 속도에 맞춰 준비하면 돼요.
student:applications.emptyText.en: Pick a program from your matches to start. You can prepare at your own pace.

student:applications.subtitle.ko: 지원서마다 체크리스트가 따로 있어요. 확인된 서류는 자동으로 다시 쓰여요.
student:applications.subtitle.en: Each application has its own checklist. Documents that have already been checked are reused automatically.

student:dashboard.arrival.noFlight.ko: 항공편을 등록하면 픽업과 첫 며칠을 함께 계획할 수 있어요.
student:dashboard.arrival.noFlight.en: Add your flight so we can plan your pickup and first days.

student:dashboard.arrival.title.ko: 비자가 나왔어요. 이제 출발 준비를 해요
student:dashboard.arrival.title.en: Your visa is ready. Let's plan your arrival

student:dashboard.counselor.noneText.ko: 플랜을 선택하면 한귤 상담팀이 서류, 에세이, 지원 전략을 내 언어로 검토해 드려요.
student:dashboard.counselor.noneText.en: With a plan, the Hangyul team reviews your documents, essays and strategy in your language.

student:dashboard.deadlines.empty.ko: 앞으로 몇 주 동안 마감일이 없어요.
student:dashboard.deadlines.empty.en: No deadlines in the coming weeks.

student:dashboard.stageText.APPLY.ko: 지원서를 준비하고 있어요. 한 번에 한 단계씩.
student:dashboard.stageText.APPLY.en: You're preparing applications. One step at a time.

student:dashboard.stageText.ARRIVAL.en: Your visa is ready. Time to plan your arrival!

student:dashboard.stageText.DECISION.en: Your applications are with the universities.

student:dashboard.stageText.ENROLL.en: Congratulations on your offer! Let's secure your place.

student:dashboard.stageText.EXPLORE.en: Let's start by getting to know you.

student:dashboard.stageText.MATCH.ko: 매칭 결과가 준비됐어요. 지원할 곳을 골라 보세요.
student:dashboard.stageText.MATCH.en: Your matches are ready. Choose where to apply.

student:dashboard.stageText.PROFILE.ko: 프로필을 완성하면 맞춤 매칭을 볼 수 있어요.
student:dashboard.stageText.PROFILE.en: Finish your profile to see your personal matches.

student:dashboard.stageText.STUDENT_LIFE.ko: 한국에 오신 걸 환영해요. 필요할 때 언제든 도와드릴게요.
student:dashboard.stageText.STUDENT_LIFE.en: Welcome to Korea. We're still here if you need us.

student:dashboard.stageText.VISA.ko: 입학 절차를 마쳤어요. 이제 학생 비자 차례예요.
student:dashboard.stageText.VISA.en: You're admitted. Next: your student visa.

student:documents.drawer.expiredText.ko: 지원서가 유효하도록 최신 서류를 올려 주세요.
student:documents.drawer.expiredText.en: Upload a current copy so your applications stay valid.

student:documents.drawer.fixDefault.ko: 이 서류는 수정이 필요해요. 수정한 뒤 새 버전을 올려 주세요.
student:documents.drawer.fixDefault.en: This document needs a correction. Upload a new version once it's fixed.

student:documents.drawer.inReview.ko: 이 서류를 검토하고 있어요. 지금은 할 일이 없어요.
student:documents.drawer.inReview.en: We're reviewing this document. You don't need to do anything right now.

student:documents.legal.intro.ko: 단계를 마칠 때마다 체크하세요. 최종 서류는 저희가 확인해요.
student:documents.legal.intro.en: Mark each step as done when you complete it. We'll verify the final document.

student:documents.privacy.short.ko: 암호화해 보관해요. 지원서를 제출하기 전까지는 나와 한귤 상담팀만 열어볼 수 있어요.
student:documents.privacy.short.en: Stored encrypted. Only you and the Hangyul team can open it until you submit an application.

student:documents.upload.countryHint.en: Decides whether an apostille is needed.

student:documents.upload.fileHint.ko: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP 파일, 최대 {{mb}}MB.
student:documents.upload.fileHint.en: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to {{mb}} MB.

student:documents.upload.subtitle.ko: 선명한 스캔본이나 휴대폰 사진이면 충분해요. 확인 후 고칠 점이 있으면 알려드려요.
student:documents.upload.subtitle.en: A clear scan or phone photo is fine. We'll check it and let you know if anything needs fixing.

student:essays.emptyText.ko: 지원을 시작하면 에세이가 자동으로 만들어져요. 직접 시작할 수도 있어요.
student:essays.emptyText.en: Essays are created automatically when you start an application, or you can start one yourself.

student:essays.new.subtitle.ko: 연습용이나 아직 목록에 없는 대학용으로 써 보세요.
student:essays.new.subtitle.en: For practice or for a university that isn't listed yet.

student:home.closestSub.ko: 아직 모든 공개 요건을 충족하지는 않아요. 부족한 부분을 정확히 알려 드릴게요.
student:home.closestSub.en: You don't meet every published requirement yet. Here is exactly what's missing.

student:home.docAction.TOO_OLD.en: Too old. Get a new copy

student:home.recommendedSub.en: Programs where you meet the published requirements.

student:housing.noDorms.ko: 이 대학은 아직 기숙사 정보를 공개하지 않았어요.
student:housing.noDorms.en: This university hasn't published dormitory information yet.

student:housing.noUni.ko: 첫 지원서를 만들면 주거 정보가 열려요
student:housing.noUni.en: Housing opens up with your first application

student:housing.noUniText.ko: 지원하면 해당 대학의 기숙사 옵션과 비용을 보여드려요.
student:housing.noUniText.en: Once you've applied, we'll show dormitory options and costs for that university.

student:housing.subtitle.ko: 기숙사 옵션을 비교하고 주거 준비 단계를 관리하세요.
student:housing.subtitle.en: Compare dormitory options and keep track of your housing steps.

student:login.aside.eyebrow.en: Study in Korea, step by step

student:login.aside.note.ko: 수많은 작은 단계도, 한 번에 하나의 분명한 다음 단계로.
student:login.aside.note.en: Thousands of small steps, one clear next step at a time.

student:login.aside.point1.ko: 나에게 맞는 프로그램을 추측이 아닌 명확한 근거와 함께 확인하세요.
student:login.aside.point1.en: See which programs fit you, with clear reasons for each.

student:login.aside.point2.ko: 모든 서류를 안전한 보관함 하나에 두고 여러 지원서에 재사용하세요.
student:login.aside.point2.en: Keep every document in one secure vault and reuse it across applications.

student:login.aside.point3.ko: 내 언어를 쓰는 실제 상담사와 함께 준비하세요.
student:login.aside.point3.en: Work with a real counselor who speaks your language.

student:login.aside.text.ko: 첫 검색부터 인천공항에 도착하는 날까지, 한귤유니가 다음에 할 일과 그 이유를 알려드려요.
student:login.aside.text.en: From your first search to the day you land at Incheon, Hangyul Univ shows you what to do next, and why.

student:login.aside.title.ko: 한국 대학 입학까지 필요한 모든 과정을 한곳에서 차분하게.
student:login.aside.title.en: One calm place for every step to a Korean university.

student:login.subtitle.ko: 하던 곳에서 바로 이어가세요. 체크리스트, 메시지, 마감일이 기다리고 있어요.
student:login.subtitle.en: Continue where you left off. Your checklist, messages and deadlines are waiting.

student:messages.emptyText.ko: 서류, 마감일, 한국 생활 등 무엇이든 물어보세요.
student:messages.emptyText.en: Ask anything: documents, deadlines, life in Korea.

student:messages.hint.en: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line

student:messages.new.subtitle.en: The Hangyul team will reply here.

student:messages.pickText.ko: 또는 한귤 상담팀과 새 대화를 시작하세요.
student:messages.pickText.en: Or start a new one with the Hangyul team.

student:messages.subtitle.ko: 한귤 상담팀과 대화하세요. 보통 영업일 기준 하루 안에 답장이 와요.
student:messages.subtitle.en: Talk with the Hangyul team. Replies usually arrive within one business day.

student:messages.visibility.ko: 나와 한귤 상담팀만 볼 수 있어요
student:messages.visibility.en: Visible to you and the Hangyul team

student:notifications.emptyText.en: We'll let you know when something needs your attention.

student:notifications.subtitle.en: Updates about your applications, documents and messages.

student:onboarding.basics.legalText.ko: {{country}}에서 발급된 공문서는 보통 한국 대학에 제출하기 전에 다음 절차가 필요해요: {{path}}. 때가 되면 단계별로 안내해 드릴게요.
student:onboarding.basics.legalText.en: Official documents from {{country}} usually need this step before Korean universities accept them: {{path}}. We'll guide you through it when the time comes.

student:onboarding.basics.residenceHint.ko: 일부 대사관은 해당 국가 거주자의 비자 신청만 받아요.
student:onboarding.basics.residenceHint.en: Some embassies only accept visa applications from residents.

student:onboarding.education.gpaHint.ko: 학교에서 사용하는 척도 그대로 평균 성적을 입력하세요.
student:onboarding.education.gpaHint.en: Enter your average on your school's own scale.

student:onboarding.education.level.en: Highest level completed or in progress

student:onboarding.education.method.ko: 내 GPA를 만점으로 나눠 0~100% 점수로 환산해 비교해요. 대학마다 환산 방식이 다를 수 있고, 학교가 특수한 척도를 쓰면 한귤 상담팀이 메모를 남길 수 있어요.
student:onboarding.education.method.en: How we compare grades: we convert your GPA to a 0–100% score using a simple linear scale (your GPA ÷ scale maximum). Universities may convert grades differently. The Hangyul team can add a note if your school uses a special scale.

student:onboarding.education.previewEmpt.ko: GPA와 만점을 입력하면 환산 점수를 보여드려요.
student:onboarding.education.previewEmpt.en: Enter a GPA and its scale to see the normalized score.

student:onboarding.goals.degreeSub.LANGU.en: Learn Korean first. A common, gentle start

student:onboarding.goals.fieldsHint.en: Choose as many as you like.

student:onboarding.goals.intake.en: When would you like to start?

student:onboarding.goals.intakeHint.ko: 한국 대학은 봄(3월)과 가을(9월)에 학기를 시작해요.
student:onboarding.goals.intakeHint.en: Korean universities start in spring (March) and fall (September).

student:onboarding.language.english.en: How would you rate your English?

student:onboarding.language.korean.en: How would you rate your Korean?

student:onboarding.language.testSub.TOPI.en: Test of Proficiency in Korean, levels 1–6

student:onboarding.language.tests.en: Which tests have you taken or plan to take?

student:onboarding.language.testsHint.en: Skip this if you haven't started yet.

student:onboarding.passport.expiryHint.ko: 가능하면 학업 기간 내내 유효해야 해요.
student:onboarding.passport.expiryHint.en: It should be valid for your whole study period if possible.

student:onboarding.passport.has.en: Do you have a valid passport?

student:onboarding.passport.inKorea.en: Are you in Korea right now?

student:onboarding.passport.noSub.ko: 괜찮아요. 비자를 신청할 때 있으면 돼요
student:onboarding.passport.noSub.en: That's okay. You'll need it later for the visa

student:onboarding.passport.numberHint.ko: 선택 사항이에요. 마지막 몇 자리만 저장하고, 전체 번호는 여권 서류에만 남아요.
student:onboarding.passport.numberHint.en: Optional. We only keep the last digits; the full number stays on your passport document.

student:onboarding.passport.previousHint.en: This can change which visa steps apply to you.

student:onboarding.passport.previousVisa.en: Have you held a Korean visa before?

student:onboarding.preferences.budget.en: Yearly budget for tuition and living costs

student:onboarding.preferences.budgetHin.ko: 대략적인 범위면 충분해요. 예산을 넘을 수 있는 프로그램을 표시하는 데 사용해요.
student:onboarding.preferences.budgetHin.en: A rough range is fine. We use it to mark programs that may cost more than your budget.

student:onboarding.preferences.housing.en: Where would you like to live?

student:onboarding.preferences.housingSu.en: Most first-year international students choose this

student:onboarding.preferences.regionsHi.en: Leave empty if anywhere in Korea is fine.

student:onboarding.preferences.scholarsh.ko: 받을 수 있는 장학금이 있는 프로그램을 강조해 드릴게요
student:onboarding.preferences.scholarsh.en: We'll highlight programs with scholarships you may qualify for

student:onboarding.sponsor.goal.en: What would you like to do after graduating?

student:onboarding.sponsor.goalHint.ko: 한두 문장이면 충분해요. 나중에 학업계획서 작성에 도움이 돼요.
student:onboarding.sponsor.goalHint.en: One or two sentences is plenty. It helps with your study plan later.

student:onboarding.sponsor.goalPh.ko: 예: 한국과 베트남 기업을 잇는 마케팅 일을 하고 싶어요.
student:onboarding.sponsor.goalPh.en: e.g. Work in marketing between Korean and Vietnamese companies.

student:onboarding.sponsor.who.en: Who will pay for your studies?

student:onboarding.sponsor.whoHint.ko: 비자 신청 시 이 사람이나 기관의 재정 증빙이 필요해요.
student:onboarding.sponsor.whoHint.en: Visa applications need proof of funds from this person or organization.

student:onboarding.steps.basics.subtitle.ko: 어떤 서류와 비자 규정이 적용되는지 알려줘요.
student:onboarding.steps.basics.subtitle.en: This tells us which documents and visa rules apply to you.

student:onboarding.steps.education.subti.ko: 입학 요건을 확인하는 데 사용해요. 지금은 대략적인 정보도 괜찮아요.
student:onboarding.steps.education.subti.en: We use this to check entry requirements. An estimate is fine for now.

student:onboarding.steps.education.title.en: Tell us about your current education

student:onboarding.steps.goals.subtitle.ko: 지금 마음에 드는 것을 고르세요. 다른 선택지는 언제든 둘러볼 수 있어요.
student:onboarding.steps.goals.subtitle.en: Pick what feels right today. You can explore other options anytime.

student:onboarding.steps.goals.title.en: What would you like to study?

student:onboarding.steps.language.subtit.ko: 공인 점수가 있으면 더 많은 프로그램이 열리지만, 점수 없이 시작하는 학생도 많아요.
student:onboarding.steps.language.subtit.en: An official score matches you with more programs, but many students start without one.

student:onboarding.steps.language.title.en: How are your Korean and English?

student:onboarding.steps.passport.subtit.ko: 기본 정보만 여쭤봐요. 여기서 여권 번호 전체를 요구하지 않아요.
student:onboarding.steps.passport.subtit.en: Only the basics. We never ask for your full passport number here.

student:onboarding.steps.preferences.sub.ko: 예산, 장학금, 주거 정보로 프로그램 순위를 정해요.
student:onboarding.steps.preferences.sub.en: Budget, scholarships and housing help us rank programs for you.

student:onboarding.steps.preferences.tit.en: What matters to you in daily life?

student:onboarding.steps.sponsor.subtitl.ko: 대학과 비자 심사관은 재정 지원에 대해 물어봐요. 목표를 알려주시면 한귤 상담팀이 더 잘 도와드릴 수 있어요.
student:onboarding.steps.sponsor.subtitl.en: Universities and visa officers ask about financial support. Your goal helps the Hangyul team help you.

student:register.captcha.failed.ko: 확인을 완료한 뒤 다시 시도해 주세요.
student:register.captcha.failed.en: Please complete the verification and try again.

student:register.captcha.unavailable.ko: 지금은 가입할 수 없어요. 잠시 후 다시 시도해 주세요.
student:register.captcha.unavailable.en: Sign-up is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.ko: 본인확인을 위한 이메일·휴대폰 번호의 국외 처리 고지를 확인했습니다
student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.en: I acknowledge that my email and mobile number are processed abroad to verify them

student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.ko: Twilio Inc.(미국)가 인증 문자와 이메일을 발송하고, Cloudflare, Inc.(미국)가 자동 가입을 차단합니다. 이전 항목·시기·보유기간·거부 방법은 개인정보 처리방침에 있습니다. 거부하면 계정을 만들 수 없습니다.
student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VE.en: Twilio Inc. (United States) delivers the verification text and email; Cloudflare, Inc. (United States) checks that sign-up is not automated. Details, including how to refuse, are in the Privacy Policy. Refusing means an account cannot be created.

student:register.consent.MARKETING.label.ko: 한국 유학 소식과 이벤트 정보를 받겠습니다
student:register.consent.MARKETING.label.en: Send me study-in-Korea news and event information

student:register.consent.MARKETING.summa.ko: 선택. 이메일 또는 문자로 받으며 언제든 수신을 거부할 수 있어요.
student:register.consent.MARKETING.summa.en: Optional. By email or text; unsubscribe any time.

student:register.consent.PRIVACY.label.en: I agree to the collection and use of my personal information

student:register.consent.PRIVACY.summary.ko: 이메일, 휴대폰 번호, 이름, 국적, 비밀번호(암호화) — 계정 생성과 보호 목적.
student:register.consent.PRIVACY.summary.en: Email, mobile number, name, nationality and password hash, to create and secure your account.

student:register.consent.TERMS.label.en: I agree to the Terms of Service

student:register.consent.canonical.ko: 한국어 원문이 법적 효력을 가지는 기준 문서입니다.
student:register.consent.canonical.en: The Korean text is the legally binding version; this translation is for your convenience.

student:register.consent.missing.en: Please agree to the required items.

student:register.consent.text.ko: 필수 항목에 동의해야 계정을 만들 수 있어요. 선택 동의는 설정에서 언제든 철회할 수 있습니다.
student:register.consent.text.en: Required items are needed to open an account. You can withdraw optional consent at any time in Settings.

student:register.done.text.ko: 이메일과 휴대폰 번호 인증이 끝났어요. 이제 나에게 맞는 프로그램을 찾아볼까요?
student:register.done.text.en: Your email and mobile number are verified. Let's find the programs that fit you.

student:register.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

student:register.errors.session.ko: 가입 세션이 만료되었어요. 처음부터 다시 시작해 주세요.
student:register.errors.session.en: Your sign-up session expired. Start again.

student:register.exists.ko: 이미 이 이메일로 가입된 계정이 있습니다. 로그인해 주세요.
student:register.exists.en: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.

student:register.fromCheck.ko: 답변이 프로필에 저장되어 가입 즉시 맞춤 추천이 준비됩니다.
student:register.fromCheck.en: Your answers are saved to your profile, so your matches are ready as soon as you sign up.

student:register.nationalityHint.ko: 국적에 따라 필요한 서류와 비자 절차가 달라져요.
student:register.nationalityHint.en: Your nationality decides which documents and visa steps apply to you.

student:register.passwordHint.ko: 10자 이상. 기억하기 쉬운 문장이 가장 좋아요.
student:register.passwordHint.en: At least 10 characters. A sentence you will remember works best.

student:register.phoneHint.ko: 문자로 인증번호를 보내 드려요. 통신사 요금이 부과될 수 있어요.
